theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcd_jwc_lipschitz_minor_ibp
theorems.statement: ∀ (k r : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (g : Fin (r + 1) → Euclid k → ℝ) (V : Fin (r + 1) → Euclid k) (ψ : Euclid k → ℝ), (∀ c, LipschitzWith L (g c)) → ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∫ x, ψ x * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun c b => fderiv ℝ (g c) x (V b)) = -∑ b : Fin (r + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (b : ℕ) * ∫ x, fderiv ℝ ψ x (V b) * g 0 x * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun (c b' : Fin r) => fderiv ℝ (g c.succ) x (V (b.succAbove b')))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
